title: How Late a Withdrawal Comes and What Is Retained of the Release
content:
A withdrawal brought long after the loss was valued has part of its release retained under the Keyturn Host Protection Plan.

- Where the latest appraisal standing on the enrolment was recorded more than half the plan's supplement window ago and money stands booked as owed to the host, the release is taken at the marketplace's late-withdrawal share of 96 percent.
- Where it was recorded more than half that window ago and no money stands booked as owed, it is taken at the marketplace's settled-withdrawal share of 98 percent.
- Where it was recorded within half that window, nothing is retained on that account.

### The window each plan publishes

| Plan | Supplement window, calendar days |
|---|---|
| Keyturn Shield 90 Host Plan | 14 |
| Keyturn Shield 85 Host Plan | 21 |
| Keyturn Shield 80 Host Plan | 30 |
| Keyturn Shield 75 Host Plan | 45 |
| Keyturn Shield 70 Host Plan | 60 |
| Keyturn Shield 60 Host Plan | 90 |

Half of the window is half of that number of calendar days: 7 on the Keyturn Shield 90 Host Plan, 15 on the Keyturn Shield 80 Host Plan, 45 on the Keyturn Shield 60 Host Plan.

### Boundary readings (hypothetical, on the Keyturn Shield 80 Host Plan)

| Days since the latest appraisal | Money standing booked as owed | Release taken at |
|---|---|---|
| 15 | either | the whole of it |
| 16 | some | 96 percent |
| 16 | none | 98 percent |

At exactly half the window nothing is retained; the readings begin once more than half has passed.
